WITH filtered_fees AS (
  SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, rebrate, feerate
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005 AND orderslink IS NOT NULL
),
order_metrics AS (
  SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND feerate != 0 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL THEN rebrate / feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio
  FROM order_metrics
)
SELECT om.orderslink, om.avg_rebtotal, om.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN om.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND om2.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND om2.mean_ratio != 0 THEN om.avg_ratio / om2.mean_ratio ELSE NULL END as relative_ratio
FROM order_metrics om
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om2
ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
